text:
Maria (CS): Hey team — preflight for Acme renewal. They want to switch to net30 but legal flagged need PO for EU entity. Can we timebox exec signoff and still close this week?
Dan (AE): They asked for pricing holdback until PO arrives. CFO prefers CC if faster.
Sophia (Legal): Confirming: EU entity requires PO on file for Accounting compliance. docusign acceptable but PO needed too.
AJ (Finance): PO is required to book revenue. If they can email a PO by EOD Friday we can proceed with net30. Otherwise need prepayment or CC.
Lina (Onboarding): Onboarding hit risk — if we don't get PO this week onboarding start shifts. Can we offer a staged onboarding (MVP access) pending PO?
Tom (Solutions): We can give limited dev keys and a sandbox seat — low risk. Documented in DocSend link: https://docsend.com/example/renewal-staged-onboard
Maria (CS): I'll shoot DocSend with a 48h expiration and call out key milestones. @Dan can you nudge the execs?
Dan (AE): On it — pinged CEO and CFO. Short note: "Can you approve PO or CC fallback by Fri 5pm PT? If PO delayed, CC to start onboarding."
Sophia (Legal): If they do CC, we need written waiver from billing stating customer will provide PO within 30 days. I'll draft a short variance template.
AJ (Finance): Works for me. We need PO text to include billing entity name, tax id, and PO number.
Maria (CS): docusign-bot, create e-sign envelope for the variance template and route to customer execs if CC chosen.
docusign-bot: Created envelope 0xA4 — will send when instructed.
Dan (AE): Customer replied — CFO says can do CC now but will try get PO next week. Asking for the variance wording.
Sophia (Legal): Draft uploaded: https://internal.redwood/legal/variance-doc — see key clause; we can copy into DocuSign body.
Maria (CS): OK I'll prepare the DocSend + DocuSign package. Plan: send DocSend w/ staged onboarding details + link to DocuSign variance. If CC accepted, get exec signature + finance ack. Target: sign + payment authorization by Fri 5pm PT.
Lina (Onboarding): I'll prep the handoff doc and a single-sprint onboarding plan that can start on Monday if we get CC cleared.
Tom (Solutions): I'll attach the sandbox access steps and rate limit guidance to the DocSend.
Dan (AE): Sending now. Will update thread once CFO confirms.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone. If we don't have confirmation by Thu 12pm PT, we escalate to AE manager for exec call.
Dan (AE): Noted. Will escalate if no reply.
Customer (CFO): "We can CC today — please send variance."
Maria (CS): Sent DocuSign envelope + DocSend. docusign-bot: Envelope sent 1767004412 to customer@acme.example — status: sent.
docusign-bot: Reminder scheduled for 48h.
AJ (Finance): Once signed, I'll process authorization for CC and flag revenue team.
Sophia (Legal): I'll close the variance once signed.
Maria (CS): Closing plan: start staged onboarding Monday, full onboarding after PO or within 30 days. Logging this in Gainsight.
Lina (Onboarding): Got it — prepping Monday kickoff.
Dan (AE): CFO signed at 16:22 PT. DocuSign status: completed. Congrats team.
Maria (CS): Awesome — moving to provisioning. I'll post final confirmation when seats live. :tada:
